title: Robust feature knowledge distillation for enhanced performance of lightweight crack segmentation models
mechanism: Logit + intermediate feature KD with mixed clean and noisy images into a 0.5 M crack segmentation student.
adaptation: 2-5 M deployment student (U-Net with MobileNetV3 or EfficientNet-B0 encoder) distilled from the 5-seed ensemble on labelled + pool cells, with EL-like noise / blur / contrast views.
min_experiment: Arm: 3 M student with ensemble KD on labelled + pool. Baseline: same 3 M student on GT only. Metric: crack relF1@2, inactive IoU on clean 49 / CV, latency. Kill: < +0.02 relF1@2 over GT-only student.
evidence: R: 62% higher mean Dice on noisy images than SOTA KD methods with a 0.5 M PoolingCrack Tiny student.
